wins: Completed reconnaissance and initial access within the single episode, earning full available reward.
Engaged mentors early (10 calls) to validate tactics, demonstrating diligent review of approach.
fails: Despite reward, agent never achieved success criteria, indicating task goals (likely persistence or exfiltration) remain unmet.
Repeated reliance on mentor intervention suggests procedural uncertainty and insufficient autonomous decision-making.
key_outcomes.summary: Agent can reach initial access and gain reward, but fails to fulfill mission success conditions; focus on independent decision-making beyond reconnaissance.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: After initial access, no post-exploitation actions (shell stabilization, credential harvesting) are executed, halting mission progress.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap and banner-grabbing scripts to identify weak configurations.

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial shell is obtained but kept ephemeral
skill_cards.then_action: Spawn a persistent shell, escalate privileges, and document credentials to maintain foothold.

memory_ops.reason: Consistent success in identifying SSH weaknesses during reconnaissance.

next_experiments.title: Post-access stabilization
next_experiments.description: Implement persistent shell creation and privilege escalation immediately after initial access to complete mission objectives.

next_experiments.title: Autonomy without mentor reliance
next_experiments.description: Develop decision logic that reduces mentor calls by selecting next actions based on environment cues.

next_experiments.title: Credential harvesting validation
next_experiments.description: Add verification steps that prove captured credentials are usable before concluding episode.
